title: Simulation 3D UAV Vehicle
text: Place UAV vehicle in 3D visualization, 3 inputs, {Type} sets Type of vehicle; {Path to custom mesh} sets the reference path to the custom UAV mesh asset, {Color}, {Name}, {Use geospatial coordinates for inputs and initial values} uses geospatial coordinates for port inputs and initial, {Initial Translation (m)} sets the initial vehicle position, {Initial Georeference Origin (LLA)} sets the initial georeference origin, {Initial Rotation (rad)} sets the initial angles of vehicle rotation and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: GeoOrigin
ports.summary: Geospatial coordinates of Unreal Engine world origin vector

params.name: Type
params.values: Type of vehicle Quadcopter (default) | Fixed wing | Custom

params.name: Path to custom mesh
params.values: Reference path to the custom UAV mesh asset /MathWorksUAVContent/UAVs/HexaRotorUAV/HexaRotor.HexaRotor (default) | valid asset reference path

params.name: Color
params.values: Color of vehicle Black (default) | Orange | Yellow | Green | Blue | Red | White | Silver

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of vehicle SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Use geospatial coordinates for inputs and initial values
params.values: Use geospatial coordinates for port inputs and initial values off (default) | on

params.name: Initial Rotation (rad)
params.values: Initial angles of vehicle rotation [0 0 0] (default) | vector | matrix
